title: 🧪 Missing Edit GET Test in TecnicosController
body:
🎯 **What:** Addressed a testing gap in `TecnicosController.cs` by implementing tests for the `Edit` GET method.
📊 **Coverage:** Tested scenarios for passing `null` as ID (returns NotFound), a non-existent ID (returns NotFound), and an existing ID (returns ViewResult with correct `TecnicoUpdateDto`).
✨ **Result:** Increased test coverage and reliability of the `TecnicosController`, protecting the `Edit` endpoint from future regressions.
